gloss: and they bordered them, made a border for them
definition: גִּבְלִי adjective, of a people of foregoing with article = collective noun Josh 13:5 והארץ הַגִּבְלִי , but read ׳ גְבוּל הַגּ , compare Di . 1Kgs 5:32 הַגִּבְלִים (but probably text error; Th reads וַיַּגְבִּלוּם and they bordered them, made a border for them (the stones); ᵐ5 ἔβαλον , compare also Klo ).

גִּבְלִי adjective, of a people of foregoing with article = collective noun Josh 13:5 והארץ הַגִּבְלִי, but read ׳גְבוּל הַגּ, compare Di. 1Kgs 5:32 הַגִּבְלִים (but probably text error; Th reads וַיַּגְבִּלוּם and they bordered them, made a border for them (the stones); ᵐ5 ἔβαλον, compare also Klo).
